description: This file defines the VersionAttribute class used for specifying version numbers on interfaces within the Orleans framework. It is part of the code generation process for grain interfaces, providing a way to annotate interfaces with version information.

classes.name: VersionAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute used to specify the version number of an interface in Orleans.

methods.name: VersionAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with a specific version number.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Method implementation for IGrainInterfacePropertiesProviderAttribute to populate interface properties with the version.
